entities.summary: Shena Mackay FRSL is a Scottish novelist born in Edinburgh. She was shortlisted for the Booker Prize for Fiction in 1996 for The Orchard on Fire, and was shortlisted for the Whitbread Prize and the Orange Prize for Fiction in 2003 for Heligoland. Shena Mackay was a authors & novelists from Edinburgh (b. 1944-06-06, Edinburgh). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
